Uagna.it
The Wolf Among Us Remastered is faithful to the original, while including a few extra touches that make it a worthwhile purchase even for those who already know Bigby’s adventure—and the stories of the other fallen fairy-tale characters—by heart. Although the gameplay remains a bit stiff, The Wolf Among Us is still an artistically original and profound title that keeps you glued to the screen. It is a well-deserved remaster, arriving in anticipation of the highly awaited new installment due for release in 2027.

COGconnected
The Wolf Among Us Remastered is a wonderful example of a remaster. Not only does it improve the visuals, but it also irons out performance issues from the original release. The detective tale is every bit as engaging as you’ll remember, expertly balancing gripping storytelling, memorable characters, and meaningful choices to deliver an unforgettable experience. With the addition of behind-the-scenes content, a noir filter and deleted scenes, this is the perfect celebration of a classic.

Oct 31, 2026
8
aydnalgl
The Wolf Among Us is a truly unique game in so many ways: - An original and intriguing setting rooted in European folklore, yet set in 1980s New York. - A compelling detective story that keeps you hooked and curious from beginning to end. - A strong protagonist, unforgettable supporting characters, and excellent characterization throughout. - Top-tier voice acting performances. - A distinctive neo-noir visual style, complete with its own retro 80s color palette. - A dark, mature whodunnit narrative that evolves from what initially appears to be an isolated murder into a much larger conspiracy, with some genuinely substantial plot twists along the way. I was just as blown away playing the remastered version in 2026 as I was back in 2013 and 2014 (I'm counting both years since the game was released episodically). Gameplay-wise, there are certainly aspects that feel rather clunky and outdated by today's standards (which is precisely why I rated it a bit lower from a modern perspective), but it's still a fantastic experience nonetheless.
PlayStation 5 Report
